title: Lifting sections from the reduced support of an adjoint
summary: For a projective ℚ-factorial dlt pair with effective rational boundary over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, we prove that the adjoint has positive Iitaka dimension whenever a nonzero effective Cartier multiple is supported on the coefficient-one boundary and restricts to a semiample line bundle on its whole reduced support. This gives log abundance after nonvanishing in dimension at most four over ℂ.
family_title: Log abundance for compact Kähler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity

review.reason: Proves positive Iitaka dimension for adjoint divisors of dlt pairs, giving log abundance in low dimensions.
